title: Indeed
paragraphs: Big sister’s friend was staring intently at Rival’s wagging tail.
“Um, nice to meet you. I also really love Naofumi-sama, so we’re comrades now.”
“Na~no!”

Perhaps because they shared the same feelings, Rival nodded at big sister’s friend’s words. Then, they tried to join hands, but since Rival was too busy clinging to Father, they offered their tail instead. Just as big sister’s friend lightly gripped that tail for a handshake—
“Na…na~no!?”
Rival shivered with a start. Then, they looked at big sister’s friend and their own tail.
“Oh, it’s rough but has a nice texture…”
“Na…na~no?”
When she stroked it gently, Rival slumped down, deflated.
“P-Please, stop—”
“Raphtalia-chan, Gaelion’s tail feels really nice to touch.”
“Eh? But…”
Big sister’s friend stopped stroking Rival’s tail. Rival then turned around with moist, pleading eyes.
“He looks like he wants more! Okay, I’ll keep doing it.”
“N-No, that’s not—”
Big sister’s friend resumed stroking Rival’s tail. Could that be their weak spot?
“Come on, Naofumi-sama, you should try stroking here too. He looks so happy!”
“Eh? Is that okay? Ah… yeah, it does feel really nice.”
“Na… Naofumi is stroking me! But not there… the place I want Naofumi to touch is—ah… no! If you keep stroking there, Gaelion will… go weird, na~no! S-Stop!”
“Why do I feel like I’m doing something really inappropriate? Could this be that rumored dragon’s reverse scale…?”

Big sister’s friend kept stroking again and again. Her movements were the same as when she stroked Kou. Eventually, as if the magic wore off, Rival reverted to a baby dragon and began trembling, trying to endure it. Kukuku… Looks like the mask has come off.
“Do it more!”
“Why are you encouraging this?”
“When I stroke Kou where he likes it, he reacts the same way, you know? Around his neck. But if I stop midway, he gets grumpy, so I’m sure Gaelion wants you to keep going too.”
“N-No! Not there… if you do that, Gaelion will… but Naofumi is stroking too… Gawww… na~nooo!”
With a thud, Rival collapsed right there, completely exhausted. They twitched and spasmed a few times.
“Umm… anyway, thanks, Rifana.”
“Hm? You’re welcome.”
“That was… surprisingly easy.”
“I’m not sure about anything inappropriate, but… Rifana might be a natural at this.”
“Maybe so.”
Ren and Itsuki are completely playing the role of bystanders. However, this is a major discovery.
“From now on, if this one tries to get sexually close to Father, big sister and her friend can be taken down like this!”
“Eh? Hmm…”
“If you love Naofumi-sama… I think Naofumi-sama should just answer them himself.”
What are you saying, big sister?! I want you to protect Father like in the first world!
“Oh my…”
“Na…na~no! I’ve been shown a terrifying world, na~no!”
“Ah, she’s back.”
“No matter what happens, Gaelion won’t give up, na~no! I’ll show that I’m a dependable big sister to conquer Naofumi, na~no!”
“Do you have some kind of plan?”
Itsuki! You must not indulge Rival’s nonsense!

“Na~no! Everything that the Spear Hero failed to explain properly, Gaelion was entrusted with by Naofumi and the others in the previous loop, na~no! For example, I remember all the enemy vanguards that exist in Fourbury and around the world, one by one, na~no!”
“Oh!” Ren and Itsuki let out voices of admiration.
Why?!
“Motoyasu’s explanations are sometimes really hard to follow, and they come out of nowhere, so that helps a lot!”

“I heard that reincarnators and transported individuals are enemies, but if you know exactly where they are, that’s a huge help. Also, because of that, the Seven Star Weapons haven’t been choosing wielders, but if challengers can be identified, someone might be chosen.”
“Ah, if offering up Naofumi’s virginity could achieve that, it’d be a great deal!”
“Come on now!”
“What? Naofumi-san said it before, didn’t he? He’s a hero, so he’s supposed to be popular, so he wanted to experience that a little. A harem is every man’s dream.”
“Ren and Itsuki agreed with that too! You both said you’d like to try it once the world was at peace!”
I can smell an ugly conflict brewing. Indeed, Rival is undoubtedly my greatest enemy.
“Ufufuun! Naofumi, Gaelion will prove that I’m a dependable big sister and win you over, na~no! But don’t stroke my tail, na~no!”
Rival, having transformed back into human form, hugged Father from behind and arched her back as big sister’s friend stroked her tail.

I’m not happy about it, but… Rival has forced her way into joining us! This means I have to strengthen Sakura-chan even more! I absolutely cannot allow Father’s virginity to be taken! And then, begrudgingly, we returned to the eastern village with Rival in tow.
“Hm? Naofumi, welcome back~”
Sakura-chan and the others greeted us. I was about to respond naturally, as usual. However…
“Ah, it’s a Filolial, na~no!”
“Huh!?”
Rival, of all things, quickly clung to Sakura-chan, making her eyes widen in shock. She looks genuinely surprised.
“Na-na-no…!? W-why is Gaelion clinging to a Filolial, na~no!?”
“You went and hugged her yourself!”
“Besides, this is Sakura, na~no! Sakura has also grown bigger and is trying to compete with Gaelion, na~no!”
“Mm… let go.”
Sakura-chan, looking annoyed, tried to push Rival away, but Rival, despite looking equally displeased, didn’t stop entangling her hands around her. What kind of harassment is this?
“Gaelion will never lose the battle for Naofumi, na~no! If Sakura is serious, I’ll go all out, na~no! Let go, na~no!”
“You’re the one clinging on, Gaelion-san.”
Father delivered a precise retort. Exactly. You’re the one who should let go.
“Exactly! Sakura-chan will be defiled! Let go!”
“Na-na-no! Filolial, na~no!”
Rival, seemingly confused and dizzy, showed no sign of loosening her grip on Sakura-chan.
“Sniff sniff sniff! Filo, na~no!”
“What nonsense are you spouting?!”
“Yaaah!”
Sakura-chan, seriously disgusted, transformed into her Filolial form and kicked Rival square in the face. But the deranged Rival showed no sign of backing down. …Should I just kill her?
“If you don’t stop, I will seriously kill you!”
“That’s right! I can smell dragon scent! Get away from Sakura!”
“Na~no! Mm…”
“I won’t let go! I won’t let go! Help me, Naofumi!”
Sakura-chan is genuinely repulsed. Seriously, what is she thinking? Yuki-chan and Kou tried to pull Rival off Sakura-chan, but she wouldn’t budge, as if rooted in place.
“I-I get it, but… maybe an Air Strike Shield could separate them…”
“Je t’aime, na~no!”
“Yaaah! Mugu—!”
Everyone was left in stunned silence.
“Oh my…”
The completely deranged Rival finally stole Sakura-chan’s lips.
“Whoa! Gaelion-san! What are you doing?!”
Father snapped back to his senses and turned his gaze to big sister’s friend. I see! He’s leaving it to the friend. However, that’s far too lenient.
“Rifana-chan! Please!”
“Okay!”
“Stop it! If you don’t quit now, I’ll kill you!”

I pointed my spear at Rival… but Sakura-chan is too close, and using a skill would be dangerous! So I thrust my spear at Rival with the intent to finish her off. But—clang!—the spear didn’t pierce her properly. Damn… if I put too much force, I might pierce through Sakura-chan as well, making it hard to go all out! But she shouldn’t underestimate my killing intent. Just as I was thinking that, big sister’s friend stroked Rival’s tail—her weak spot.
“Na~no!?”
Rival jerked back violently and blinked repeatedly as if she had come to her senses. And then…
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaah! Why did Gaelion kiss Sakura, na~no?!”
With a swoosh, Rival leapt away from Sakura-chan, putting some distance between them.
